svg.title: How much of each movie the checks cover
svg.text: How much of each movie the checks cover
Darker is more of a stretch's frames covered; one pixel is 319 frames; a tick every 36,000 frames, about 10 minutes.
A movie the harnesses run no row of shows only its first two tracks.
any% movie: 129,712 frames, 199 rows of the lock
low% (13%) movie: 167,797 frames, 5 rows of the lock
100% movie: 222,788 frames, 415 rows of the lock
Spore Spawn RTA movie: 33,342 frames, 2 rows of the lock
